description: Source code for an authentication and authorization backend API using FastAPI, implementing token-based auth, RBAC, user management, password hashing, and segregation of duties.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Provides methods for user authentication, token creation/validation, password hashing, user management, and role assignment.

methods.name: None set_registration_enabled(enabled: bool)
methods.description: Set runtime registration enablement flag.

methods.name: bool is_registration_enabled(default_env: str = "true")
methods.description: Get whether registration is enabled, considering runtime override and environment variable.

methods.name: List[str] _normalize_roles(raw_role: str)
methods.description: Normalize legacy roles to current RBAC roles.

methods.name: AuthService.__init__
methods.description: Initialize AuthService with a database connection.

methods.name: AuthService.hash_password
methods.description: Hash a password using PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256.

methods.name: AuthService.verify_password
methods.description: Verify a password against stored hash and salt.

methods.name: AuthService.create_token
methods.description: Create a signed bearer token containing user info and roles.

methods.name: AuthService.decode_token
methods.description: Decode and validate a bearer token, supporting test tokens.

methods.name: AuthService.get_current_user
methods.description: Retrieve and validate the current user from credentials, auto-provision for test tokens.

methods.name: AuthService.create_user
methods.description: Create a new user in the database with hashed password and roles.

methods.name: AuthService.authenticate_user
methods.description: Authenticate user credentials and generate token.

methods.name: AuthService.assign_role
methods.description: Assign an additional role to an existing user.

methods.name: AuthService.enforce_sod
methods.description: Enforce Segregation of Duties: prevent submitter and approver from being the same person.
